events.verdict: Wagner (ORL) places his off-arm against LeVert (ATL) prior to stepping back and the contact is marginal.
Isaac (ORL) is off-balance when he engages with Okongwu (ATL) during the rebound and the ensuing contact is marginal.
Wagner (ORL) extends both hands into Okongwu (ATL), affecting his trajectory during the shot attempt near the basket.
The ball is last touched by Daniels (ATL) prior to it going out of bounds.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) establishes himself in a screening position in Okongwu's (ATL) path and does not deliver contact.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on LeVert (ATL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. The ball is last touched by Black (ORL) prior to it going out of bounds and possession is given to Atlanta when play resumes.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) legally contests Okongwu's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Isaac (ORL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Okongwu's (ATL) jump shot attempt does not make contact with the rim and the shot clock expires prior to Orlando possessing the ball.
Okongwu (ATL) jumps alongside Banchero (ORL) when he jumps in the air to release the pass and the body contact that occurs is marginal.
Young (ATL) briefly grasps Wagner's (ORL) arm prior to releasing to receive the throw-in.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
Isaac (ORL) firms up in a screening position in Okongwu's (ATL) path and does not deliver contact.
Okongwu (ATL) legally contests Banchero's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Banchero (ORL) places his hands on Young's (ATL) body but the contact is marginal.
Young (ATL) releases the ball prior to stepping out of bounds.
Daniels (ATL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Wagner (ORL) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
